system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: system_prompt = """You are a helpful assistant. Make sure to return in a WELL-FORMED JSON object."""
system_prompt_style.note: System prompt is a fixed string; the meta-agent user prompt (base) embeds the archive and domain text, which is why this is coded templated. Line numbers are not given in the bundle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Currently, we only evaluate Meta Agent Search on single-step QA tasks in this paper.
env_context_strategy.note: The tasks are QA and ARC grids with no repository environment. The task info is passed as taskInfo only.

context_compaction.note: The search.py loop was truncated or not included in the bundle. Seed agents manually slice inputs, for example qd_inputs[-3:], but this is agent code, not harness code.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Make sure to return in a WELL-FORMED JSON object.
observation_format.note: Model outputs are JSON fields. Observations are Info objects and text.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: the meta agent only needs to program a “forward” function to define a new agentic system
tool_call_format.note: The meta agent emits JSON containing a code field. That code is executed.

tool_count.note: The framework code (LLMAgentBase, search.py) is not in the bundle. There are no function-calling tools as such.

edit_primitive.note: Not an editing harness. The tool registry is not visible in the bundle.

tool_schema_source.note: The schema-producing code is not in the bundle.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency file or grep is available in the bundle.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: In Meta Agent Search, a "meta" agent iteratively *programs* interesting new agents in code based on previous discoveries.
loop_primitives.note: Iterative archive-based search of candidate agents with evaluation; closest to multi_attempt (could also be read as generate_test_repair). Run loop code not in excerpts.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: **Insights:**\nYour insights on what should be the next interesting agent.
planning_granularity.note: The quote contains an escaped newline as it appears in the Python source.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a meta agent iteratively programs interesting new agents based on an ever-growing archive of previous discoveries
multi_agent_topology.note: There is one meta agent. The generated agents use multiple LLMAgentBase modules, for example debate.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Conditioned on the archive, the meta agent designs a new agent
delegation_mechanism.note: This is a low-confidence reading of the prose. The run loop itself was not visible.

human_in_loop.note: The run loop is not in the bundle.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: add them to an archive that stores discovered agents, and use this archive to help the meta agent in subsequent iterations
long_term_memory.note: The archive of prior agents persists across search iterations.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The design then undergoes two self-reflection (Madaan et al., 2024; Shinn et al., 2023) steps by the meta agent to ensure it is novel.
self_verification.note: The generated agent is also evaluated on validation data, which is why test_execution is included.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: repeating this process up to five times if necessary

termination_condition.evidence_quote: the process continues with the updated archive until the maximum number of iterations is reached

cost_controls.note: The paper uses GPT-3.5 for evaluation to cut cost. This is an experiment choice, not a harness control.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The code in this repository involves executing untrusted model-generated code.
execution_isolation.note: The paper claims containerized execution (Sec. 6). The repo README only warns of risk, which is why subprocess is coded. The execution code was not visible.

eval_hooks.note: Each domain's search.py evaluates on its benchmark (ARC, DROP, MGSM and others).

target_domain.evidence_quote: Replace `{DOMAIN}` with the specific domain folder name {`_arc`, `_drop`, `_mgsm`, ...}
target_domain.note: The system does automated agent design over QA and reasoning benchmarks.

open_source.note: The licence comes from the README badge. LICENSE:1 is not in the bundle.

model_agnostic.note: The shipped code uses the OpenAI API. The paper transfers agents to Claude models, but the code path for that is not seen.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: All code is open-sourced at https://github.com/ShengranHu/ADAS.
primary_artifact.note: The research code is frozen to the paper.

first_release_date.note: No tag or first commit is in the bundle. The paper v1 date is not in the evidence; the arXiv id 2408 suggests 2024-08.

pinned_version.note: The pin is a main-branch commit with no tag. Only the short hash is given in the bundle.

stars.note: The star count comes from the evidence header and is not date-stamped.
